keyPoints: Information collection is the starting point of digital literacy: gathering data/facts from digital sources before it can be evaluated or used.
It requires the skill to identify credible sources (websites, surveys, forms) and use appropriate digital tools to gather relevant information efficiently.
Good information collection underpins every later digital literacy skill, since evaluation, communication and content creation all depend on having accurate raw information to start from.
modelAnswer: Information collection is the starting point of digital literacy because a person needs relevant information before communicating or publishing ideas. Information can be collected from books, websites, videos, surveys and other sources. The collected information is then evaluated, organized and converted into clear digital content for a target audience.
stem: Explain the role of information collection in the field of digital literacy.

keyPoints: Information collection: gathering data from digital sources.
Technical skills: using digital devices/software competently.
Communication and collaboration: expressing ideas and working with others using digital tools.
Digital content creation: producing text, graphics, video or other media.
Ethics and responsibility: using digital tools and information responsibly and respecting cultural/social boundaries.
Together these components let a person function effectively and responsibly in a digital-first world.
modelAnswer: The key components are digital search and information literacy, technical skills, communication, collaboration, digital content creation, and ethics and responsibility. Search literacy helps a learner find, understand and evaluate information. Technical skills enable the use of devices and software. Communication and collaboration support clear, respectful work with others. Content creation turns ideas into posters, videos, presentations or other digital products. Ethics and responsibility require respect for cultural, social and religious differences and responsible sharing.
stem: Analyze the key components of digital literacy and their significance.

keyPoints: Information extraction is the process of identifying and pulling out the most important, relevant facts from a larger body of information.
Its purpose is to filter out unnecessary detail so that only the key ideas needed for a task (e.g. a report, a presentation, a poster) remain.
This makes the information easier to understand, summarize and present to an audience.
modelAnswer: Information extraction is the process of identifying the main points that are most relevant to a purpose from collected data. It requires understanding the material, focusing on key information, evaluating its relevance and reliability, and then presenting the selected ideas clearly to an audience.
stem: Define information extraction and its purpose.

keyPoints: Billboards rely heavily on large, simple, high-contrast images since they are viewed briefly, often by moving traffic.
Graphics are used to instantly communicate the core message (a product, a brand, an event) without requiring the viewer to read much text.
Effective billboard graphics balance color, size and placement so the image is legible and impactful from a distance and at speed.
modelAnswer: Images and graphics make a billboard attractive and help communicate its message quickly to people who are on the move. A billboard should have a clear purpose, a highlighted key message, coordinated text, logo, colours and pictures, and a balance between text and graphics. The pictures should support the message instead of overshadowing it, and the design should remain simple, legible and appropriate for the target audience.
stem: Illustrate the use of images and graphics in billboard design.

keyPoints: Social media has shifted communication from primarily one-to-one to one-to-many and community-based interaction.
YouTube lets creators broadcast video content to a global audience, changing how people learn and are entertained.
WhatsApp enables instant, low-cost group messaging and calling across distances, replacing much traditional SMS/phone communication.
Together these platforms have made communication faster, more visual, and more globally connected, though also raising concerns about privacy and misinformation.
modelAnswer: Social media is an effective contemporary communication tool for audio and video calls, sharing information and reaching audiences. Businesses use it to reach customers and promote products, while users share content and communicate with others. YouTube supports worldwide video sharing, learning, entertainment and marketing. WhatsApp is a digital communication tool used for messaging and sharing information, so both platforms can connect people and distribute content quickly. Users should share authentic, reliable content because social media can also spread misinformation and disinformation.
stem: Discuss the impact of social media on contemporary communication, referencing YouTube and WhatsApp as examples.
